No OSM candidate is a verified campus bus stop.
Way/relation locations use geometry bounding-box centers; these can be outside the building polygon and are not entrances.
OSM WGS84 source coordinates have not been converted to GCJ-02.
Only named/ref/address-tagged elements in the mapped campus area were fetched.
Gate coverage is incomplete: one named gate found. Duplicate source objects and stale names exist.
Chinese source names are preferred; English names contain observed number conflicts and are intentionally excluded as aliases.
Public Overpass was used twice serially for this one-off snapshot; do not call it as a production autocomplete backend.
